description: PhytoMethods V2.3 科学证据穿透与文献原始出处索引

records.claim: String Graph 传递边约简定理：若存在路径 u -> w -> v 且偏移相容，则边 u -> v 为拓扑与序列冗余边，边数上限降为线性规模
records.citation: Myers EW. (2005). The fragment assembly string graph. Bioinformatics, 21(suppl_2), ii79–ii85.

records.claim: 参考无关单碱基错误率与 Phred QV 数学反演公式：E = 1 - (K_shared / K_total)^(1/k), QV = -10 * log10(E)
records.citation: Rhie A, Walenz BP, Koren S, Phillippy AM. (2020). Merqury: reference-free quality, completeness, and phasing assessment for genome assemblies. Genome Biology, 21(1), 245.
records.sectionLocator: Methods: Base accuracy and QV calculation

records.claim: 三维基因组染色质接触概率幂律衰减模型 P(s) ∝ s^(-α)，分形球模型下 α ≈ 1.0，平衡球模型下 α ≈ 1.5
records.citation: Lieberman-Aiden E, van Berkum NL, Williams L, et al. (2009). Comprehensive mapping of long-range interactions reveals folding principles of the human genome. Science, 326(5950), 289–293.
records.sectionLocator: Scaling of contact probability with genomic distance

records.claim: YaHS 多分辨率迭代加权拟合与内部接触密度断崖式骤降侦测切除错组装算法
records.citation: Zhou C, McCarthy SA, Durbin R. (2023). YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool. Bioinformatics, 39(1), btac808.
records.sectionLocator: Methods: Contact matrix construction & Error correction

records.claim: 四倍体马铃薯全 48 条染色体单倍型无混杂组装与等位有害突变机制解析
records.citation: Sun H, Jiao WB, Krause K, et al. (2022). Chromosome-scale and haplotype-resolved genome assembly of a tetraploid potato cultivar. Nature Genetics, 54(3), 342–348.

records.claim: Verkko 混合长读段组装引擎：以 HiFi 建立同聚物压缩 MBG 图，并以 ONT 超长读段穿透着丝粒与复杂异染色质闭合 T2T
records.citation: Rautiainen M, Nurk S, Walenz BP, et al. (2023). Telomere-to-telomere assembly of diploid chromosomes with Verkko. Nature Biotechnology, 41(7), 1017–1024.

records.claim: Lander-Waterman 测序统计学模型：碱基覆盖泊松分布 P(X=k)=e^(-C)*C^k/k! 与缺口概率 P(X=0)=e^(-C)
records.citation: Lander ES, Waterman MS. (1988). Genomic mapping by partial digestion, random clones, libraries, and interrupted mapping: Theoretical considerations. Genomics, 2(3), 231–239.
